stories.text: 🪦 Gather 'round: Mel's Mediocre Mob's obituary has been posted (13.24 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Mr. Action Jackson vs Gibb it to Me Baby. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Mr. Action Jackson 76% / 49%, Gibb it to Me Baby 76% / 43%.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 64% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 24% with none (now 44%).
🏟️ Game to watch: WSH @ NYG (Thursday 8:15 PM), 6 league starters in action with 63.65 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (WSH @ NYG): 6 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Mr. Action Jackson vs Gibb it to Me Baby (23.39 pts projected).
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ TEN: JAX −2.5 at open, JAX −10.5 now. 8 league starters in it, led by B. Tuten (Kyle Tucker).
📈 LINE MOVE: SF @ DAL: DAL −1.5 at open, SF −3.5 now. News: "49ers trade for Colts' Keenan Allen to bolster injury-plagued WR room"
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1 would have helped both TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace!.
🛒 WAIVER WIRE MVP: Ramosverse's pickups have put 381.58 pts into its starting lineup this season, led by Stroud (109.48 pts) and McLaughlin (88.00 pts).
🤝 Rivalry week: Claremont In Yo Stace! leads Ruffing the Passer 3–2 all-time.
📰 Dolphins put QB Malik Willis on IR with groin injury. That's Mr. Action Jackson's starting QB. Developing.
🤔 What could have been: If TDsMaGee and Mr. Action Jackson had swapped Jayden Daniels for Tyler Warren back in Week 6, both would be ahead (+1 and +3 wins).
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 13% against Mr. Action Jackson — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted Mr. Action Jackson after the favorite flipped 8 times.
